name: arXiv:2609.12978 - SeqMoE: Toward Full-Load Performance via Predictive and Graph-Compatible MoE Offloading
notes: arXiv:2609.12978v1 [cs.OS], submitted 2026-09-11, the only version on the abs page. The HTML header says 'License: arXiv.org perpetual non-exclusive license' and names no accepted venue, so this source is the preprint. Authors Zihan Wang, Yuqi Wang, Lei Gong, Cheng Tang, Wenqi Lou, Teng Wang, Chao Wang, Xuehai Zhou, all University of Science and Technology of China (Hefei or the Suzhou Institute for Advanced Research). The abstract links no code repository, and a search for a SeqMoE implementation repo on 2026-10-18 returned only the arXiv page and secondary summaries, so code_url on the paper record is null. HTML of v1 read on 2026-10-18: abstract, Sections 1-2, Section 8 (graph-compatible runtime, implementation, prefill offloading) and Section 9 (methodology, end-to-end numbers, prediction accuracy, overhead). The absolute tok/s in Figure 6 are drawn in the figure and are not in the HTML text, so they are not recorded; the percentages in Section 9.2 are. Every number in the paper record comes from that HTML. The paper is its own measurement; there is no independent reproduction.
